purpose: Independently documented SWEX 2022 enhanced-observation periods with no Sundowner regime assigned in the primary campaign instrumentation paper. These are validation-only negative windows and are not inferred from absence of an IOP label.
source: Witte et al. 2026, Geoscience Data Journal, NSF NCAR's In Situ Sensing Facility Measurement System During the Sundowner Wind EXperiment (SWEX), doi:10.1002/gdj3.70074, Table 1
interpretation_rule: Only EOP rows explicitly shown with no Sundowner regime in Table 1 are marked verified_negative. All other non-IOP campaign times remain unlabeled.

windows.notes: Witte et al. Table 1 labels EOP 1 with no Sundowner regime; 8 ISS2 and 8 ISS3 radiosondes plus RF06/RF07 observations were collected.
Witte et al. Table 1 labels EOP 2 with no Sundowner regime; 8 ISS2 and 7 ISS3 radiosondes plus RF12/RF13 observations were collected.
Witte et al. Table 1 labels EOP 3 with no Sundowner regime; 10 ISS2 and 10 ISS3 radiosondes plus RF16/RF17 observations were collected.
